issue.title: CI: replace JDK 15 with 16

labels.name: area/housekeeping
labels.description: Issue type for generalized tasks not related to bugs or enhancements

issue.body:
## Description
JDK 16 reached GA a few weeks ago and the natural cycle would be to replace the jobs in Quarkus CI that are currently running on JDK 15 with JDK 16.
Our EA test job/workflow [1] is still running on 16 (and not 17-ea) because there are still some problems, especially with Kotlin and Gradle.
The idea is to get the EA job to the point where we can make the switch (both for CI JDK 15 -> 16 _and_ EA job 16 -> 17-ea).

[1] https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/actions/workflows/jdk-early-access-build.yml (see also #15867)

FTR:
- https://quarkusio.zulipchat.com/#narrow/stream/187038-dev/topic/Gradle.207
- https://quarkusio.zulipchat.com/#narrow/stream/187038-dev/topic/Quarkus.20tested.20on.20Java.2016
- https://groups.google.com/g/quarkus-dev/c/AlyXp2A2W5Y

/cc @gsmet @gastaldi 

### Currently known TODOs (potentially incomplete)

- [x] fix or work around [KT-43704 `Illegal reflective access by com.intellij.util.ReflectionUtil to method java.util.ResourceBundle.setParent(java.util.ResourceBundle) `](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KT-43704)
  - [ ] update to Kotlin 1.5 (see also: #16806)
  - [ ] **or** (try to) skip all Kotlin bits in the entire repo for now
  - [x] **or** set `--add-opens java.base/java.util=ALL-UNNAMED` via `MAVEN_OPTS`
    - [x] stop `BootstrapMavenOptions` from passing `--add-opens` etc. to Maven `CliManager` (which chokes on that), see also #16862
    _note: complete **HACK** currently (in my fork), must be done properly_
- [x] work around [Gradle 6 not being compatible with JDK16+](https://github.com/gradle/gradle/issues/13481)
  - [x] don't execute `devtools/gradle` and `its/gradle`
  - [x] exclude anything related to Gradle from `devtools/cli` tests
- [x] mitigate XStream problem in its/main: https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/16195#issuecomment-830872415
- [x] mitigate IAE in elytron-security-ldap: https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/16195#issuecomment-830874787
- [x] add workaround for Surefire `java.io.tmpdir` problem: https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/16195#issuecomment-830860621
- [x] fix inoker failures in its/container-image
- [x] check/fix remaining "Integration Tests - Devtools" failures
- [x] check/fix "Integration Tests - Kotlin" failures
- [x] check/fix TCKS failures
- [ ] ...?

For now checked TODOs can be found in my fork: https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/compare/main...famod:jdk16-fixes

issue.body:
First step for #16195.
See also: https://quarkusio.zulipchat.com/#narrow/stream/187038-dev/topic/Quarkus.20tested.20on.20Java.2016/near/237676424

I tried to divide everything in commits than can be addressed individually later, e.g. when fault-tolerance is fixed that one commit could be reverted.

I think the most controversial commit is the first one with `--add-opens`.
After a chat with @aloubyansky I decided to at least make sure it isn't propagated to tests via `MAVEN_OPTS` (which might spawn their own `mvn` subprocesses).
I suggest to keep `excludedEnvironmentVariables` _permanently_ because I think we generally don't want that propagation (until further notice).
I'm currently testing a `--illegal-access=warn` alternative to that `--add-opens` but I'm not convinced it's that much better.

For that `tmpdir` commit see https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/16195#issuecomment-830860621 and https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/16195#issuecomment-831523787. It's a bit of a mess currently but I didn't see a better solution until something in `jboss-parent` and/or Surefire changes.

body: Well, the main idea is to make Java 16 work with Quarkus. I would be even more happy if I don't need to add any additional arguments to make it work. But it complains for `java.base/java.util` when I changed the version to 16 and tried to rebuilt the application.

@fabasoad
What exactly doesn't work in your app so that you need `--add-opens`? Do you have a stacktrace or even a reproducer?
Depending on where you are hitting this problem, I might be able to offer you a workaround until that `BootstrapException` is fixed or Java 16 support has been fixed in the repsective area.

Most things should just work on Java 16. We are working on a few known Java 16 issues:
- Gradle (upstream issue, but fix already available which means we have to upgrade/adapt)
- Kotlin (upstream issue, but fix already available which means we have to upgrade)
- `elytron-security-ldap` (probably upstream issue, analysis pending)
- `fault-tolerance` (upstream issue, fix is already in the works)
- `rest-client` (probably upstream issue, analysis pending)
- JUnit ParameterResolver in some cases (upstream issue)

It seems it's something related to JUnit ParameterResolver because it reproduces on a `@ParameterizedTest` where I pass `RuntimeException` as a parameter via `@MethodSource`.

```
./mvnw -Dquarkus.http.test-port=9001 -e -X clean install
```

issue.title: Java 16+: Don't exec AllConfigGenerator as long as --add-opens is required
issue.body:
This is currently the only reason the EA job is failing: https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/actions/workflows/jdk-early-access-build.yml

The EA job is on `17-ea` already but turns out that this problem already exists with Java 16 (must have slipped through).

Once (if) merged, I will add a note to #16862 and/or #16806.
